reason: A browser-side visual toy that adds a draggable slingshot widget, temporarily animates UI elements as breakable targets, and restores them after the effect.

summaries.zh: 为 dsh 网页界面添加可拖动的弹弓互动玩具，用视觉动画击碎并恢复界面元素。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable slingshot toy to the dsh web interface that visually shatters and restores UI elements.

capabilities: Adds an interactive slingshot widget to the web interface
Temporarily clones and hides targeted UI elements for visual animation
Persists widget position, sound preference, and score in localStorage
Generates optional sound effects with WebAudio
